title: Forward Error-Oriented Iterative Refinement for Eigenvectors of a Real Symmetric Matrix
summary: In this paper, we discuss numerical methods for the eigenvalue decomposition of real symmetric matrices. While many existing methods can compute approximate eigenpairs with sufficiently small backward errors, the magnitude of the resulting forward errors is often unknown. Consequently, when high-precision numerical solutions are required, the computational cost tends to increase significantly because backward errors must be reduced to an excessive degree.
